SELECT
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name" AS system_name
FROM "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" itss
    ON itss."it_specialist_id" = its."id"
JOIN "systems" s
    ON s."system_id" = itss."system_id"
ORDER BY its."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, s."system_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

FROM "it_support_specialists" its

    ON itss."it_specialist_id" = its."id"
JOIN "systems" s
    ON s."system_id" = itss."system_id"
ORDER BY its."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, s."system_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

ORDER BY f."description" ASC NULLS FIRST;
